$schema_note: The backtest corpus. This file is the DENOMINATOR of the headline metric,
so every count here is verified against the State Water Board's own index
Two-tier honesty on every record. `index_verified` means the document's
existence, number and URL were read off the Board's index page.
`document_read` means the PDF itself has been parsed and its action verb,
priority cutoff and gage trigger extracted. A record can be index-verified
and not document-read, and the backtest must never score a record whose
expected action came from anywhere but the document itself.

base_orders.significance: Finding 8 states the Board issued this order to correct its own incomplete curtailment list. This is the strongest single artifact in the project.

addenda.significance: The July 22 2025 suspension. Watermaster District field flows moved the USGS rating curve, flows read above 75 cfs, and curtailment was lifted. This is the canonical human-overrules-the-machine fixture.

series.data_quality_note: The Board's own index page is internally inconsistent on two order numbers. Its order list names WR 2022-0162-DWR and WR 2022-0167-DWR, while the addendum sections beneath refer to WR 2021-0162-DWR and WR 2021-0167-DWR. Recorded rather than silently normalized. The year must be resolved from the PDFs before either record is scored, because an order number is an identifier in a legal record and guessing at one is exactly the class of error this project exists to prevent.
